nodes.meaning: A version-exact CyberAlchemy Context that consumes a bounded ontology projection without becoming ontology truth.
One complete gap-free semantic event prefix and its exact governance joins.
A deterministic derivative view calculated only from canonical per-node and per-relation events at one exact cut.
Immutable evidence of an upstream owner decision retaining its exact identity, version, digest, scope, challenge route, and evidence references.
The versioned business-to-system boundary that admits only the declared v2 endpoints, map, direction, payload, failures, and challenge routes.

bridge_contract.acl_translation: GovernanceDecisionEvidenceEnvelope -> exact GovernanceEvent joined to ExactSemanticEventReference

challenge_contract.owner_route: governance context owner plus ontology-lifecycle context owner
challenge_contract.blocking_rule: A supported challenge blocks only dependent product claims and cannot silently rewrite canonical history.

rules: Canonical per-node and per-relation events are the only replay source.
Contexts consume projections and never create alternate ontology truth.
Governance evidence crosses downstream without authority transfer.
Missing, stale, mixed, reversed, or unverifiable selected dependencies fail closed.
A projection, snapshot, graph, system ontology, or adapter output can never become a canonical event source.
claim_ceiling: A passing D65-S3 receipt proves only that this capability-local business ontology prototype is coherent, source-current, challengeable, and testable.
